fact: The Ministry of Social Solidarity says the social registry holds 13 million registered households, is cross-linked by national number with partner government databases, and that Law 12 of 2025 made it the single source for all cash-support databases nationally.
title: قواعد بيانات منظومة الحماية الاجتماعية تحتوي على 13 مليون أسرة مسجلة
